images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original production sprite atlas for a fixed 2:1 isometric fantasy tactical game. Chunky crisp PIXEL ART, low noise, limited earthy palette, clean block silhouettes, no existing game/style copying. Transparent RGBA background. Exact 8 columns by 4 rows, evenly spaced equal square slots, no margins between slots, no labels, no text, no guide lines. Canvas 2048x1024. Each sprite wholly inside its 256x256 slot with transparent padding; same footprint width 200px with 2:1 diamond plane; all base diamonds at same baseline near bottom (y220 within slot). Light top-left, left face medium, right face dark. Flat floor tiles are shallow diamond slabs, walls chunky full cubes, doors freestanding panels on shallow diamond plinths, ladders on small shallow plinths. Each row is one coherent material theme. Columns in EVERY row: 1 floor slab; 2 solid full-height wall block; 3 liquid slab; 4 rough-ground slab with scattered obstacles; 5 door aligned with down-right isometric axis (wooden panel); 6 door aligned with down-left axis; 7 low wall on down-right axis; 8 short ladder/climb piece. Row1 STONE DUNGEON: granite flagstones, mossy masonry wall, teal flooded water, rubble/crates, iron-banded wood doors, stone parapet, ladder. Row2 CAVERN: smooth grey cave stone, irregular chunky rock wall, dark blue pool, scree, stone slab doors, stalagmite low wall, ladder. Row3 FOREST: dark grassy floor, blocky trunk-and-canopy obstruction, shallow clear water, brambles, plain timber gates, log barricade, ladder. Row4 MIRE: peat floor, mangrove root block, murky olive water, reeds/mud, worn timber doors, wood fence, ladder. Important no shadows outside each sprite, no painterly gradients, no glossy 3D render. These are original isolated reusable game assets, precisely arranged, not a scene.
